resources.string: Phone as a Bluetooth remote for the TV
Ready. Pick your TV below to connect.
Bluetooth is off. Turn it on and open the app again.
This phone cannot act as a Bluetooth keyboard (the HID device profile is missing).
Bluetooth permission is needed. Allow it in the phone\'s app settings.
No paired devices yet. Follow the steps at the bottom.
Could not start the remote. Close the app and open it again.
Could not connect. Pair the TV first, then try again.
Some characters cannot be typed and were skipped.

1. Tap “Make phone visible”.
2. On the TV open Settings, Remote and accessories, Add accessory. Choose this phone and confirm the code on both screens.
3. Back here, tap your TV under Paired devices to connect.
4. Use the pad. Hold a key down to hold it on the TV.

If the TV does not list the phone, or the phone cannot connect, remove the old pairing on both sides and start again. Some phones do not allow the Bluetooth keyboard profile.
